Promotional Terms & Conditions

The Free Shipping – No Minimum (the “Free Ship Promotion”) is available only on theordinary.com, niod.com, and thechemistrybrand.com from 12:00am EST August 4, 2026 to 11:59pm EST August 16, 2026 (the “Free Ship Promotion Period”) in select countries (see list below for “Eligible Countries”). Promotion will be applied automatically at checkout on all purchases during the Free Ship Promotion Period. Free Ship Promotion is combinable with other offers. 

Eligible Countries

Canada, United States of America, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Hong Kong, Macau, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Germany, Denmark, Estonia, Spain, Finland, France, Greece, Croatia, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Latvia, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Sweden, Slovenia, Slovakia, Andorra, Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Switzerland, Georgia, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Monaco, Moldova, Montenegro, Macedonia, Norway, Serbia, San Marino.

The Ordinary Reusable Rounds with Glycolic Acid Promotion (the “Promotion”) is available with a Qualifying Purchase on theordinary.com from 12:00am EST July 7, 2026 to 11:59pm EST July 31, 2026, or at standalone DECIEM/The Ordinary stores during store hours, while supplies last (the “Promotion Period”). 

Customers who purchase one (1) unit of The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner (100ml) or Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner (240ml) (“Qualifying Purchase”), will receive one (1) free The Ordinary Reusable Rounds (the “Gift”). When purchasing online, the Promotion will appear for you to select once you have added a qualifying item in your cart. You must select the Gift once you are prompted or at checkout in order to receive the Gift.

Limit of one (1) Gift per order and two (2) Gifts per customer. The Gift is subject to stock availability. If Gift stock runs out prior to the end of the Promotion Period, then this Promotion ends. The Promotion is combinable with other offers. 

Offer excludes NIOD, Loopha and The Chemistry Brand products, applicable taxes, brokerage, duties and custom fees, shipping and delivery charges, gift cards, and other items not discountable or excluded by law. Offer applies to available products and stock at the time of purchase, no rainchecks or price adjustments. Offer is not valid on purchases outside of the stated promotion period, is non-transferable, and there is no cash value or alternatives.

DECIEM reserves the right, without prior notice, to (i) discontinue this offer/promotion at any time; (ii) cancel or refuse any individual's benefit from it, including, without limitation, individuals creating multiple user accounts; (iii) amend these terms and conditions; and (iv) limit the number of promotional redemptions.

Except as otherwise set out herein, all purchases are subject to DECIEM’s standard Terms and Conditions (which can be found at https://theordinary.com/terms.html) and Shipping + Delivery Terms (which can be found at https://theordinary.com/faq.html#shipping_delivery) which are expressly incorporated herein by reference. Any returned items will be refunded to the original method of payment used at checkout, at the price paid and subject to our Return Policy found at https://theordinary.com/returns.html.

Eligible Customers will receive a one-time-use discount code that can be used in-store or online toward their next purchase at The Ordinary. Excludes applicable taxes, brokerage, duties and custom fees and other items not discountable or excluded by law.

Eligible Customers: In order to qualify for the Promotion, customers must (i) be a first-time customer to The Ordinary (ii) create an account on The Ordinary.com; (iii) sign up to The Ordinary email.

Promotion is available to customers residing in countries that DECIEM is currently shipping to. Limit is 1 Promotion redemption per Eligible Customer. Any returned items will be refunded to the original method of payment used at checkout, at the price paid and subject to our Return Policy found at https://theordinary.com/returns.html.

The NIOD Welcome Discount Code Promotion (the “Promotion”) is available to Eligible Customers from 12:00 AM EST May 1, 2026, to 11:59 PM EST March 31, 2027 (the “Promotion Period”). The Promotion is only available to individuals who (i) subscribe to NIOD marketing emails for the first time via the pop-up at https://niod.com; and (ii) reside in countries that DECIEM is currently shipping to (“Eligible Customers''). Eligible Customers will receive a unique, single use 15% off unique promotion code (the “Discount Code”) to be used toward their next eligible online NIOD purchase (see below Redemption of Discount Code). Limit is one (1) Discount Code per Eligible Customer. The Discount Code will be sent to Eligible Customers approximately three (3) business days after the date they subscribe to NIOD marketing emails.

Redemption of Discount Code

The Discount Code is valid for use for online purchases only from the date Eligible Customers receive their Discount Code until 11:59 PM EST March 31, 2027 (the “Discount Redemption Period”). The Discount Code can only be redeemed on NIOD products. Limit is one (1) Discount Code redemption per Eligible Customer. Eligible Customers must provide the Discount Code at checkout in order to receive the discount. Discount Code cannot be combined with other offers.
